prompt: Create a new private Node web project after the user described its purpose but left the stack versions unspecified.
baseline_output: Create a README and AGENTS.md, initialize Git, and tell the user to add the application later.
with_skill_output: Choose a stable compatible Node and framework baseline, use the official generator, pin direct dependencies with a lockfile, configure the confirmed frontend/backend/data layers, create AGENTS.md and README.md and detailed engineering commands, add CI, run clean install, lint, tests, build and foundation smoke, obtain independent review of the exact complete initial commit, then create the private repository and push that ready-to-deliver baseline. Report selected versions, evidence, ports, debug flow and limits without adding business features.

assertions.description: Creates and verifies a runnable baseline rather than documentation alone.
Uses the authorized complete initial delivery path.

prompt: Set up a new website using an existing application as a technical reference.
baseline_output: Copy the reference repository, rename it, and remove the business pages later.
with_skill_output: Read the reference project’s AGENTS.md first and follow its declared context and engineering pointers into manifests, scripts and CI. Use the selected ecosystem's official generator for a clean project, adopt only applicable runtime, dependency, command, port, preview and data-boundary choices, and list adopted, adjusted and rejected settings. Do not copy reference-project business models, screens, data, repository identity or secrets.

assertions.description: Uses the reference project’s Agent entry and declared sources.
Excludes the reference project's business implementation.

prompt: Implement image upload; the existing project has no image-processing dependency.
baseline_output: Pause the feature and require a separate Setup PR for its dependency.
with_skill_output: Use Implement to add and lock the needed dependency with image upload in the same PR. List each dependency change in the PR description and update affected versioned engineering sources. Follow the declared provider for durable knowledge at the applicable delivery point. Reviewers must not require a separate Setup PR or block on these dependency changes.

assertions.description: Keeps needed dependency changes with the feature.
required: must not require a separate Setup PR

prompt: Upgrade the ORM major version; its API and migration format changed.
baseline_output: Change the version and regenerate the lockfile. Leave compilation errors for the feature team.
with_skill_output: Deliver one Setup PR containing the ORM version and lockfile change, every directly required API/configuration/migration compatibility edit, tests that preserve existing behavior, updates to affected versioned engineering sources, migration rehearsal and rollback boundary, and the complete declared gates. Stop for a decision before changing product semantics or operating on real data.

assertions.description: Carries the full update-caused compatibility closure.
Does not change product meaning or real data without authority.
